newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: S&P upgrades Brierley to BBB from BBB-.
newsitem.headline: S&P upgrades Brierley to BBB from BBB-.

text.p: Credit ratings agency Standard and Poor's said on Wednesday it had raised its corporate credit rating on Brierley Investments Ltd to BBB from BBB-.
S&P said the rating outlook was stable.
Brierley's commercial paper rating was affirmed at A-3.

S&P said reduction in Brierley's direct exposure to Thistle Hotels plc, which listed in October 1996, had improved its apparent asset liquidity position and simultaneously reduced the concentration of its asset base.
"These very positive benefits are to some extent offset by a near doubling of leverage at the Brierley parent company level," S&P said.
It said the potential for variation in the magnitude of Brierley group borrowings was to some extent offset by the liquidity inherent in its listed investment portfolio.

"Nevertheless, the continued trade in assets may at any point in time result in a lesser proportion of the portfolio invested in these relatively liquid assets. This uncertainty limits further improvements in the ratings," S&P said.
